fusions.name: Still, Then Gone
fusions.desc: A sudden strike at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 32 frost damage and always crits, up to 1.5 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Darting Chill
fusions.desc: Flicks a cold bolt that deals 4 frost damage, with a 20% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 2 seconds. You move 10% faster for 2 seconds after.

fusions.name: Sunning Pause
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Basking Watch
fusions.desc: In daylight, your dodge chance rises by 10%.
